This app has apparently discovered a groundbreaking new data visualisation concept: graphs with absolutely no axis labels. No values on the X-axis, no values on the Y-axis, no scale indicators, nothing. Just vibes.

A chart without numerical references is not “minimalist UX”, it’s functionally useless. How exactly are users supposed to interpret trend movement, variance, or data magnitude when there’s no quantitative context? Am I looking at a tiny fluctuation or a catastrophic drop? Nobody knows.

The entire purpose of a graph is to communicate data clearly. Removing axis markers and scale labels completely destroys interpretability and makes the analytics experience borderline meaningless.

Please learn the difference between “clean design” and “missing critical information architecture.”
